slides: Your muscles aren't a bank—they're a budget.
Every rep spends calories, micro‑damage, and hormones.
If you don’t allocate sleep, protein, and movement, you go bankrupt.
Debt shows up as soreness, fatigue, and stalled gains.
Pay the interest daily: 7‑9 h sleep, 20‑30 g protein per meal, active recovery.
Future‑self alignment beats willpower.
Willpower is a flash; alignment is a current.
Map today's micro‑decisions to the person you’ll be in a year.
When a choice mirrors that map, friction disappears.
Pick the option that your future self would thank you for.
Energy isn’t a reservoir you dip into—it’s a flow.
Food, light, and movement are entry ramps; stress and stagnation are tolls.
If the on‑ramps are clogged, traffic backs up and you stall.
Clear the ramps: eat nutrient‑dense, get morning sun, move every hour.
A smooth flow keeps you alert without the crash.
Momentum isn’t about speed; it’s about leverage.
A tiny habit creates a fulcrum point in your routine.
Once the lever is set, each additional action requires less effort.
Ignore the urge to sprint; keep the lever steady.
Build one lever and watch the whole system lift.
